  • Method Details

    • fromFile

      public void fromFile(String path) throws IOException
      Loads the desktop entry that's in the given path.
      Parameters:
      path - Path to the given Desktop Entry
      Throws:
      IOException - if the file cannot be read or doesn't contain a valid Desktop Entry.
      See Also:
      • fromFile(File path)

    • fromFile

      public void fromFile(File file) throws IOException
      Loads the desktop entry that's in the given path. It reads from the file line a line checking that the first line (ignoring comments) is the [Desktop Entry] category and that all keys have a value. It adds each key/value pair in the corresponding category.
      Parameters:
      file - The file to be loaded
      Throws:
      IOException - if the file cannot be read or doesn't contain a valid Desktop Entry.
